name: anim_jyu_idle
subject: a huge, heavy bear man made of glossy brown paint with messy cream splotches, a big round belly, a grumpy face with the mouth closed, straight thick human legs with bare human feet
desc: Idle loop: slow calm breathing, the big round belly and chest rise only slightly (subtle, not inflating), the heavy shoulders roll a little, thick brown paint keeps dripping and sagging from the chin, the belly and the hands, sticky drips stretch and fall, the heavy body sways a little. Stays in place with both feet planted. The face keeps the same grumpy stern look with the mouth closed. Thick, sticky, viscous paint.
